title: Step 28 almost-Killing Bochner correction
scope: Exact formula for the correction to the Bochner identity when Z is almost-Killing

weitzenboeck_decomposition.setup: ω = Z♭, σ = L_Z g, A = antisym(∇Z), S = σ/2 = sym(∇Z)

collapse_scale_analysis.setup: Fiber scale ε, average |Z|² ~ ε², Vol ~ ε^k Vol_B

regime_1_tau_equals_epsilon.correction: τ² Vol/∫|Z|² ~ ε² · Vol/(ε² · Vol) = O(1)
regime_1_tau_equals_epsilon.consequence: ⟨b²⟩ ≤ 2Λ + O(1), bracket bounded but correction doesn't vanish

collapse_scale_analysis.requirement: The almost-Killing bridge requires ||L_Z g|| = o(|Z|) in an average sense; i.e. the Lie derivative must be sublinear in the field norm. This is a quantitative condition on the N-structure at the collapse scale.

verification_against_model.H3_model_check: For the diagonal H3 model with exact Killing Z=∂_{φ₃}: σ=0, correction=0, the formula reduces to the verified ∫(2k₃²+b²/2)c²w = ∫Ric₃₃ c²w.
verification_against_model.CH2_check: For CH² horosphere data with σ=0 (exact Killing on noncompact CH²): the pointwise integrand |∇Z|²-Ric(Z,Z) = 4c² > 0 cannot integrate to zero, independently confirming incompatibility with compactness.

research_judgment: The exact Weitzenböck formula converts the Bochner center bound from 'requires genuine Killing' to 'requires ||L_Z g||²·Vol/∫|Z|² → 0'. This is a quantitative, checkable condition at the collapse scale. The bridge from C⁰ Ricci pinching to this condition passes through Kapovitch-Wilking/Naber-Zhang N-structures, where the local nilpotent groups act as approximate isometries with quantitative Lie-derivative control that must be verified against the collapse geometry.
